_note: Portraits that were picked by eye, because the picture a service hands out for these artists is the wrong person. Pass this to scripts/backfill_artist_images.py with --portrait-map so a later run does not put the wrong picture back. A value is either a path to the picture already stored in the library's image folder, or a URL of a picture that was checked by eye. The mzl.* set cannot be taken automatically: on 蔡琴's page it opens on a photograph of a man, and the set the page returns changes between requests. 2026-11-08: Apple Music's own artist picture was a stock photo of a cowboy for 清水翔太 and a girl group's stage shot for 安哲逸, so both were replaced with a portrait checked against the artist's own album covers.
